Titles.eng: Doraemon: Nobita and the Knights of Dinosaurs
Titles.jpn: 映画ドラえもん のび太と竜の騎士

Summaries.eng: Nobita and Doraemon were finding out the truth about a real dinosaur.  Nobita saw something under the ocean when they come across a cave that leads to an underground world full of dino-people. Nobita and his friends are amazed by their new discovery but sadly their memories must be wiped and must return to earth.
